szoveg_eredeti:
Free new dish for all early Starlink customers

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt); megjelent: 2026-11-03T22:28:40+00:00; link: https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2117745806996340890; média: 1 kép]
Starlink is formally rolling out free dish upgrades for its earliest customers.

“Eligible customers who were among the first to connect with Starlink, and who are still using a first-generation kit can receive a new Standard kit at no cost. Customers will be provided with a free mount, and they can opt in for free installation. If you are eligible for this upgrade, you will receive an invitation by email.”

More info: https://starlink.com/support/article/1f3e61e1-e601-86b7-7cc6-28c8cceadb61
